message.content:
Sure thing! To craft a trip that feels just right for you, could you let me know a bit more about your plans?

| What I’d love to know | Why it matters |
|-----------------------|----------------|
| **Length of stay** (e.g., 3‑5 days, a week, a month) | Helps me pick the right mix of sights, day‑trips, and downtime. |
| **Travel dates / season** | Weather, crowd levels, and special events vary a lot across the year. |
| **Budget range** (per person, including flights, lodging, food, activities) | Allows me to recommend accommodations, dining, and experiences that fit. |
| **Interests / priorities** (art & museums, food & wine, history, shopping, nightlife, day‑trips, etc.) | Makes sure the itinerary hits the spots that excite you most. |
| **Travel style** (luxury, mid‑range, budget, solo, family, couple, group) | Influences accommodation choice, transport options, and activity pacing. |
| **Any special requirements** (dietary restrictions, mobility needs, etc.) | Ensures everything is accessible and enjoyable for you. |

Once I have those details, I can put together a personalized itinerary—including flight suggestions, hotel recommendations, daily plans, transport tips, dining spots, and a rough budget breakdown. If you’d prefer a ready‑made sample plan instead, just let me know and I’ll whip one up!
